author: denz75
body:
As the other comment stated you are showing us your world stats.

In the case of your world gear being the same as raid setup I have to say that 10 times Surtr with your 5k Magic, GM2 and high crit is a sample too small to determine actual probability. With sample being so small it would be perfectly normal that you just got unlucky with crit rolls.

To reach "safe" 0.5 deviation you would need to spend much more time on that surtr.

​

On the other hand why no wyrm song?

​

body:
Hey! Since you're up against Surtr I'll give you an heads up, the Bleeding status actually lowers the chance of landing a critical hit (you can read it yourself in the in-game codex). 

So probably the discrepancy is caused by your luck in the run regarding Coup de Grace usage.
